data_fields.donor_constant: General 2, Trade 3, LFG 4, Roleplay 5, Society 6-9, Olthoi 10

best_idea: A per-recipient squelch set (account squelches, per-speaker channel bitmasks, one global mask) checked at each delivery site, with masks that collapse to all-channels when every channel is set, so a squelched speaker is removed from fan-out.
decision_why: Keep the recipient-side set, per-channel bits, collapse-to-all rule and fan-out check; give each Frankendom channel a bit (zone, party, guild, global, whisper); move the gag countdown to the server tick with a data-driven duration; fix the echo-before-gag and loop-embedded disable-switch defects.
acceptance: A server test has player B squelch player A on global chat: A's global line is absent from B's delivery list; A's whisper still delivers if B has not squelched the whisper bit; after B squelches all channels the stored mask equals the all value, and removing one channel leaves the others squelched.
